name: One dial: who decides what
title: One dial: who decides what
story: A matrix of six decisions against the four autonomy levels. A dial moves from manual to full auto one level at a time, and the cells that change flip from you to agent one row at a time: assisted lets the agent start and file ready cards, autonomous lets it answer its questions and steer, split or close cards, full auto lets a card merge once its gates pass. Two rows stay with the person at every level.
